title: Design System: Kyle Young Swiss Engineering Dossier

display.purpose: Layered hero identity, oversized project titles, and architectural headline moments.

headline.purpose: Large section transitions and project narrative statements.

body.purpose: Readable descriptions, case-study context, and supporting project copy.

label.purpose: Navigation, coordinates, figure labels, roles, systems tags, and measurement marks.

shadows.name: hero-frame
shadows.purpose: Separate the framed poster field from the off-white page without making it feel like a card.

shadows.name: portrait-cutout
shadows.purpose: Give the monochrome portrait enough separation to interlock with the typography.

motion.name: hero-load-reveal
motion.purpose: Navigation, social, role, and annotation entrance.

motion.name: scroll-parallax
motion.value: GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub offsets from 6px to 18px
motion.purpose: Subtle scroll-dependent shifts between portrait, bridge layers, and name layers.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: Disable parallax and reveal transforms under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Hero Frame
components.description: Near-full-viewport framed Swiss poster field for the homepage identity composition.
components.css: .ds-hero-frame { min-height: calc(100vh - 36px); border: 1px solid #0B0C0C; border-radius: clamp(14px, 2vw, 24px); background: #F1EFE8; color: #0B0C0C; box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(11, 12, 12, 0.08); overflow: hidden; padding: clamp(14px, 2vw, 26px); }

components.name: Hero Navigation
components.description: Small monospaced internal navigation distributed across the top of the hero frame.
components.css: .ds-hero-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; gap: 18px; font: 700 0.68rem/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-hero-nav a { color: #0B0C0C; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-hero-nav a:hover, .ds-hero-nav a:focus-visible { border-bottom-color: currentColor; outline: none; }

components.name: Layered Name
components.description: Duplicate display typography layers that move behind and in front of the portrait cutout.
components.html:
KYLE YOUNG
KYLEYOUNG
components.css: .ds-layered-name { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 56vh; overflow: visible; } .ds-name-back, .ds-name-front { font: 900 clamp(6.6rem, 18.6vw, 19.8rem)/0.78 Archivo, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.038em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-name-back { z-index: 2; } .ds-portrait { position: absolute; z-index: 3; max-height: 80%; filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.12); } .ds-name-front { position: absolute; z-index: 4; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Bridge Linework
components.description: Responsive Golden Gate bridge drawing used as compositional structure, not as tourist imagery.
components.html: <svg class="ds-bridge" viewBox="0 0 1200 360" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M40 238 C290 68 910 68 1160 238"/><path d="M80 246 H1120"/></svg>
components.css: .ds-bridge { position: absolute; inset: 18% -8% auto -8%; width: 116%; height: auto; overflow: visible; } .ds-bridge path { fill: none; stroke: #0B0C0C; stroke-width: 3; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; } .ds-bridge.is-blue path { stroke: #587B9B; opacity: 0.42; }

components.name: Role Statement
components.description: Lower-right secondary identity label that supports but does not compete with the name.
components.css: .ds-role { position: absolute; right: clamp(18px, 4vw, 60px); bottom: clamp(32px, 7vw, 84px); margin: 0; max-width: 18ch; font: 700 clamp(1.45rem, 3vw, 3.1rem)/0.98 Archivo, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.03em; text-align: right; } .ds-role span { color: #587B9B; }

components.name: Social Links
components.description: Quiet vertical social link stack placed in the lower-left of the hero frame.
components.css: .ds-socials { position: absolute; left: clamp(18px, 4vw, 60px); bottom: clamp(28px, 6vw, 76px); display: grid; gap: 9px; font: 700 0.68rem/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-socials a { color: #0B0C0C; text-decoration: none; } .ds-socials a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #315F7C; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Hard-edged ink action button for primary case-study links outside the hero.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid #0B0C0C; background: #0B0C0C; color: #FBFAF4; font: 700 0.72rem/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #315F7C; border-color: #315F7C; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(49, 95, 124, 0.48); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Work Row
components.description: Editorial selected-work row that proves engineering capability without turning the hero into a card grid.
components.html:
01 / RESEARCH

Additive Manufacturing Thermal Research

Thermal imaging, test data, and process analysis.
components.css: .ds-work-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(140px, 0.35fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: clamp(18px, 4vw, 56px); padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 72px) 0; border-top: 1px solid #D8D5CC; } .ds-work-row h3 { margin: 0; font: 700 clamp(2rem, 4.8vw, 5.6rem)/0.92 Archivo, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.035em; } .ds-work-kicker { font: 700 0.68rem/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #587B9B; }

components.name: Technical Placeholder
components.description: Evidence-pending media treatment for projects that need real CAD, plots, or test artifacts before final polish.
components.css: .ds-technical-placeholder { min-height: 260px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #D8D5CC; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(88, 123, 155, 0.08), transparent); color: #737574; font: 700 0.72rem/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
